dim_resolutions.name: chn_set
dim_resolutions.predicate: name NOT NULL AND (memmem(name,'man') OR memmem(name,'Man'))
dim_resolutions.notes: 5.74% of 3140339 char_names; substring via memmem on .off+.dat

filters.predicate: kind_id == movie_kind_fk AND production_year != NULL_INT AND production_year > 2005
subject_id == cast_fk AND status_id IN complete_status_set
person_role_id != NULL_INT AND person_role_id IN chn_set

join_order.notes: Sequential scan title.kind_id and title.production_year; emit t_id when match

join_order.probe: movie_keyword via offsets_only index per t_id
join_order.notes: FIRST semi-join: highly selective (~0.76% per title). For 4 elements, hash_set lookup or linear scan; use small hash_set. Break on first match.

join_order.probe: complete_cast via offsets_only index per surviving t_id
join_order.notes: Only ~1653 t_ids reach here; cc has avg ~0.5 rows per movie. Inline 2-3 element comparisons; break on first match.

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via offsets_only index per surviving t_id
join_order.notes: Filter info_type_id==101 AND lexicographic string_view(info) > '8.0' (varlen via .off+.dat). Project mi_idx.info string_view for MIN aggregation.

join_order.probe: cast_info via offsets_only index per surviving t_id
join_order.notes: Skip NULL_INT person_role_id (sentinel INT32_MIN). Test membership in chn_set; break on first match. Project the matching chn_id for chn.name MIN lookup.

data_structures.chn_set: std::bitset/std::vector<bool>(3140340) indexed by FK; ~393KB fits L2 cache, O(1) lookup, dense PK FK = dim_index+1 so use fk-1 or fk as index directly with size 3140340
data_structures.min_aggregation: per-thread {min_chn_name, min_mi_info, min_t_title} as std::string_view or buffered std::string; final reduction across threads

parallelism.scope: parallel scan of title table; each thread does full pipeline per surviving t_id and maintains thread-local MIN trio; reduce at end
parallelism.notes: Dim sets built once on main thread before parallel region; chn_set bitset is read-only and shared.

fk_convention_note: All FKs in fact tables are 1-indexed against 0-indexed dim arrays (FK = dim_index + 1). Confirmed empirically: title.kind_id values 1..7, complete_cast.subject_id values 1..2, mi_idx.info_type_id values include 101.
